text:
maria: Customer C-943 opened a ticket: canary rollout 'rollout-abc' stuck showing "In progress" in Console; health donut never updates. They ran status check and API returns 202 but no further ticks in chart.
ashish: 202 means accepted — do they show subsequent status events? paste the raw response if possible.
maria: Customer sent this minimal repro (sanitized):
```
$ curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/rollouts/rollout-abc/status
{
  "rollout_id": "rollout-abc",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "updated_at": "2026-02-25T14:12:08Z"
}
```
sam: Any recent deploys for status-sync? Could be consumer crash/backlog.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: canary-status-sync svc v1.3.7 -> prod by ci/cd at 2026-02-25T14:10:55Z
lina: v1.3.7 changed retry/backoff behavior. I noticed it might skip emitting the `canary_rollout_progress` metric on transient failures. If metric never emitted, Console charts would stall.
nashish: Quick checks: DB write exists (status=in_progress, updated_at 14:12), but Grafana shows a gap for `canary_rollout_progress` from 14:10-14:40 for worker=status-sync. Consumer lag shows ~0 (not reading). Logs show status-sync process crashed at 14:11 with NPE after the backoff change.
maria: Customer says they saw the first tick at 14:09 then nothing; Console tooltip shows "last update: 14:12". They attached logs showing repeated 202s then silence.
sam: Root cause hypothesis: write path persists state to DB but Console relies on events from status-topic for charting. If the emitter died, dashboard won't get new points even though DB is correct.
nashish: Two remediation options:
1) Admin re-emit: `./admin emit-rollout-event --id rollout-abc --type progress --force` — pushes event to status-topic, Console should pick it up in ~10s.
2) Restart/redeploy status-sync to pick up hotfix if available.
lina: There's a PR with nil-checks for the retry path. I'll fast-track review.
maria: Customer asked about ETA and billing/traffic impact.
lina: This is a visibility/analytics bug only. Control plane uses DB state for routing; traffic split is unaffected. Confirmed no impact to actual inference routing.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0583 — Canary status sync regression. Assigned: ashish. Severity: medium.
nashish: Starting canary rollout of status-sync v1.3.8 with the nil-check and a consumer-health probe. Rolling update across 2 pods first, ETA ~20m.
(deploy logs)
deploy-bot: rolling update status-sync -> v1.3.8: pod/status-sync-1 replaced
deploy-bot: rolling update status-sync -> v1.3.8: pod/status-sync-2 replaced
ashish: Pods healthy, consumer lag cleared, re-emitted backlog for last 30m. Charts now showing ticks. :thumbsup: 
maria: Customer confirmed Console updated and rollout moved to "completed". Closing the escalation; will attach postmortem when ready.
nashish: Postmortem will call out root cause (nil pointer in retry logic), mitigation (consumer healthprobe + ensure metric emission), and follow-ups (integration test for metric emission on transient errors). ETA: EOD doc.
lina: Support playbook update draft: when customer reports "stuck in progress" -> check for recent status-sync deploys, verify `canary_rollout_progress` metric and consumer lag, attempt admin re-emit, restart status-sync if consumer crashed.
maria: Thanks all. Logged notes in ticket and linked incident. Customer asked for postmortem link when available. :eyes:
